title: Pathflow latency surface: cohort selector and streaming-flag decomposition by model/route
creator: Sofia Kim
description: Build a new Pathflow Latency Surface dashboard that shows p50/p95/p99 latency across model + route slices with a streaming vs non-streaming decomposition and interactive cohort selector. The goal is to make it straightforward for SRE and runtime engineers to identify hotspots that only appear for streaming IO paths or for specific request shapes (conversation-length, token-output, prefix hit rate). This ticket covers telemetry plumbing (trace hooks, metric tags, log enrichment), pipeline transforms (OTel collector -> metric histogram labels), and the Grafana dashboard panels + canned drilldowns to traces and example requests.
acceptance_criteria: A Grafana dashboard named 'Pathflow Latency Surface' exists in the Observability folder with panels for p50/p95/p99 across model and route matrix
Dashboard includes toggle to split streaming vs non-streaming and retains cohort selector for request-shape (input tokens, output tokens, conversation turns)
Traces linked from p99 cells open to the relevant trace with tags: model, route, io_mode, servepath_id, batch_size
Prometheus/OpenTelemetry metrics include a latency histogram with labels: model, route, io_mode, servepath_id; backfilled at least 7 days of rollup metrics for sampling window
Log pipeline enriches request logs with servepath_id and kv_cache_hit boolean for correlation panels
Playbook section added describing steps to triage streaming-only tail latency regressions and how to trigger targeted canary queries
tasks: Instrument runtime: add io_mode label (streaming|sync) to latency histograms and counters - ENG/infra work
Extend trace hooks to attach servepath_id, kv_cache_hit, batch_size, and model_variant tags to spans
Update OTel collector mapping rule to convert span attributes into Prometheus labels and ensure cardinality guardrails
Create Grafana dashboard panels: matrix heatmap (models x routes) for p95, waterfall trace samples for selected cell, cohort selector UI
Add log enrichment rule in log pipeline to append servepath_id and kv_cache_hit -> Loki/GCS logs
End-to-end test: generate synthetic streaming and sync requests with controlled kv cache behavior; validate dashboard differentiates them
design_notes: We chose a matrix + cohort approach instead of a single timeseries so engineers can surface cross-dimension interactions (e.g., model A on route X only regresses when streaming and batch_size>8)
To control label cardinality, servepath_id will be a short hashed id and only included for trace links and a lower-cardinality 'servepath_bucket' label will be added for aggregated metrics
Metric approach: use summary/histogram buckets for latency with exemplar support so we can attach trace IDs from high quantile buckets
Logging: don't duplicate large request payloads; only include pointers (request_id) and the minimal enrichment attributes to correlate with traces and metrics
Dashboard UX: default view shows p95 heatmap; user can switch to p50/p99. Streaming-split toggle persists across dashboard sessions. Clicking a cell opens a trace sample list filtered to that slice
